Description
 We are partnering with a leading Nordic financial services group to transform their compliance operations through Generative AI. Collaborating directly with the client’s Compliance department, our team builds intelligent knowledge retrieval systems and autonomous AI agents that streamline regulatory analysis and risk workflows within a high-security banking environment.
 Requirements
Core Engineering: Strong proficiency in Python, API development, containerized deployments, and modern MLOps/LLMOps practices. GenAI & Cloud Expertise: 4+ years in software/AI engineering with hands-on experience deploying production LLM solutions on Google Cloud Vertex AI.
RAG & Agentic Systems: Proven experience building RAG / Knowledge Engineering architectures (vector databases, semantic search) and AI Agent frameworks (orchestration, memory, function calling).
 Job responsibilities
Vertex AI Engineering: Design, deploy, and scale production GenAI applications on Google Cloud’s Vertex AI, focusing on reliability, latency, and enterprise security.
RAG & Knowledge Engineering: Architect end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines—including document parsing, chunking, embeddings, and hybrid search—to ground AI outputs in complex regulatory documentation.
AI Agent Development: Build and orchestrate autonomous and human-in-the-loop AI agents capable of multi-step reasoning, tool integration, and automated compliance task execution.
